Their descriptors are declared explicitly ## below because Live Data only derives descriptors from the class named by the className parameter. ## ## Only the columns that fit the width of a standard page are displayed. The Live Data table has no column width ## of its own: it lays the columns out from their content and, when the total exceeds the page, it scrolls sideways ## with nothing indicating that a column is out of view, while the leftmost columns shrink to their 4rem minimum and ## break their text mid-word. The creation date and the free text summary are therefore hidden rather than dropped: ## the Properties panel offers exactly the properties listed below, so a property left out of the list cannot be ## displayed back at all, whereas a listed one whose descriptor is not visible is offered there unchecked and costs ## no table width, its column being hidden rather than absent. ## ## The list is sorted on the creation date, most recent changes first, since that is what a reader of this list ## looks for.
